name: Mother Lode Job Training — Reentry Employment
description: AJCC operator for Tuolumne, Calaveras, Amador and Mariposa counties; federally funded program to reduce participant recidivism through job training and placement. Federal award PE386112260A6 ($998,343).
address: 197 Mono Way, Suite B, Sonora, CA 95370

name: Columbia College
description: Services: Affordable education, career training, university transfer programs, tutoring, counseling and support.

name: Sonora Adult School
description: High School diploma classes in a self-paced course of study with one-on-one consultation, counseling and individualized instruction.

name: Tuolumne County Superintendent of Schools
description: Among its many programs and services, TCSOS has several initiatives to serve the unique needs of public education in Tuolumne County. These initiatives include Career Technical Education (CTE), Early Childhood Education, Immunize Tuolumne, and Mental Health.

name: Valley Mountain Regional Center (VMRC) Prevention and Development
description: Services for developmentally disabled persons of all ages in Tuolumne, Calaveras and Amador counties. Service coordination is available to people whose developmental disability originated before age eighteen, can be expected to continue indefinitely and constitutes a substantial handicap. Other services: genetic counseling, specialty clinical services, self-advocacy, and residential placement.
address: 704 Mountain Ranch Road, #203, San Andreas, CA 95249

name: MEWU:YA - Tuolumne Me-Wuk Indian Health Center
description: Offers a variety of traditional and non-traditional options for both adolescents and adults in Tuolumne County. All age groups accepted. One-on-one counseling, group counseling, Native Circle 12 Step Recovery Program, Medicated Assisted Treatment along with support, problem solving skills, and empower individuals and families to address mental health.

name: Tuolumne County Behavioral Health Department
description: Offers individual, group, and family treatment for persons with a substance abuse or addiction problems. The Perinatal Program provides specialized alcohol and drug treatment for pregnant and/or parenting women. Short-term residential services are determined by medical necessity and include group counseling.

name: Tuolumne County Behavioral Health Peer Enrichment Center
description: The Enrichment Center, a peer-run community center which is open to community members 18 years of age and older, provides recovery and wellness supports to those who are living with a mental illness, recovering from drug and/or alcohol addiction, experiencing homelessness and those released from incarceration.
who_it_serves: Explicitly serves people on parole/probation or returning from incarceration (per program description)

name: Family Urgent Response System (FURS) Hotline
description: Free 24/7/365 support for current and former foster youth and their caregivers with concerns or those who are in crisis. Provide safe, judgement-free, and private support during critical moments through the statewide hotline and at the local level through mobile response teams to help stabilize your situation and keep you safe. Follow-up services can help connect you to local services and support.

name: Adventist Health Sonora Hospital
description: Offers a variety of healthcare services & emergency care.

name: Forest Road Health and Wellness Center, Adventist Health
description: Pain management, rehabilitation, podiatry and other health services. All services accept medi-cal.
address: 93 South Fairview Lane, Suite B, Sonora, CA 95370

name: M.A.C.T. Medical Clinic
description: Our clinics are specialized and allow patients to receive affordable care for most Medical, Dental, Behavioral Health, Optometry, and Chiropractic needs. Medical services are available to all Native Americans, their family members, and the public.
address: 13975 Mono Way, Suite G, Sonora, CA 95370

name: Mathiesen Memorial Health Clinic
description: Providing family medical care for all ages. Medi-Cal, CMSP, Medicare and most insurances accepted. Provides treatment for illnesses and injuries that do not require a visit to the emergency room but need timely attention.

name: ATCAA Emergency Housing Services
description: Food bank, rental & utility and housing assistance. Center For a Non-Violent Community Emergency Shelter

name: Central California Legal Services
description: Public interest law firm established for the purpose of providing free civil legal assistance to low-income individuals, families, organizations, and communities. The Merced office serves eligible individuals in Merced, Mariposa, and Tuolumne counties. Day Reporting Center

name: District Attorney/Victim Witness Assistance Center
description: Provides services to all victims of crime, including court escort and filing of Victims of Crime Compensation Applications. Facilitates counseling services to eligible crime victims and survivors.

name: Interfaith Legal Services
description: Assists with legal concerns including landlord/tenant, name changes, harassment, elder abuse, simple wills, transfer on death deeds, title transfers, trust amendments, small claims actions, family law advice, probate issues, grand jury complaints, repossessions, consumer finance, contractor issues, mechanic’s liens, scams, and notary services.

name: Jamestown Family Resource Center
description: Offers several programs and services including service referrals for homeless families, emergency food and clothing, school supplies such as backpacks and more, resource referrals and connections, and other health referrals and classes focusing on topics such as nutrition, parenting, health, ESL, and basic life skills, after school programs, and a variety of support and recovery groups.

name: Lambert Community Center
description: Internet access for job search and support for applications, benefits specialist, food available daily, referral to other community resources and needs, social and emotional support and faith-based resourcing.

name: Nancy’s Hope Community Center
description: Programs to help with clothing, food, household, and utility needs.

name: Blue Zones Project - Tuolumne County
description: Encourages changes in our community that lead to healthier options. Offers community walking groups, cooking classes, exercise classes, Purpose Workshops, and more. For more information and schedule of group events visit website.

name: Addiction Recovery Al-Anon/Alateen Family Groups
description: Al-Anon is a worldwide fellowship of relatives and friends of alcoholics who share their experience, strength, and hope in order to solve their common problems. Alateen is for teens ages 12-19. Meetings in Groveland, Sonora, Soulsbyville, Angels Camp, Murphys, Arnold, and Mountain Ranch. Meetings held in person and on-line (Zoom) see website calendar for dates, times and locations.

name: Alano Club of Sonora
description: Recovery Group meetings include AA-Alcoholics Anonymous meetings 7 days a week, NA-Narcotics Anonymous 6 days a week, OA-Overeaters Anonymous and SLAA-Sex & Love Addicts Anonymous.

name: Sierra Bible Church Celebrate Recovery Group
description: Recovery groups and meetings.

name: Mathiesen Memorial Red Feather Clinic
description: Medication assisted treatment, accepts all insurances, walk-ins welcomed. Services provided: 6 Substance use treatment medications, behavioral health referrals, substance use counseling, education, care coordination, assist with health insurance enrollment, resource referrals, and acupuncture therapy. Medi-Cal accepted.

name: Mother Lode Job Training – America’s Job Center of California
description: Employment career center for job seekers and employers. There are no fees involved. Designed as a self-directed system. Monday – Friday 8:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. Resources include internet 28 access for job search purpose, telephone for job search, resume assistance, job listings, career counseling, information on training, and education and related supportive services.
address: 197 Mono Way, Suite B, Sonora, CA 95370

name: California Employment Development Department (EDD)
description: Information on state services for unemployment, and job seekers.

name: All Saints Catholic Parish Food Pantry
description: Food pantry open on Tuesdays, 9:30 a.m. - 11:45 a.m. (except for the third Tuesday of each month).
address: 23260 Joaquin Gully Road, Twain Harte, CA 95383

name: Amador Tuolumne Community Action Agency (ATCAA) Food Bank
description: Community food bank serving local food pantries and providing regular food distribution for qualified individuals, families, children, and seniors, as well as holiday food baskets.

name: CalFresh Food - Tuolumne County Department of Social Services
description: Applications for assistance with food purchases for those who qualify. Eligibility requirements are set by State and Federal government.

name: Christian Heights Assembly of God Church Food Pantry
description: Offers a free meals as well as referrals to other community resources and Needs.
